ghostFire.qualification: Naturally granted live active GhostFire instance; its original callback requires a valid prepared Pending Ghost Fires interface and a legal hostile target within 800 units.
ghostFire.normalGrant: DT_Accessory RandomDrink -> GE_Accessory_RandomDrink_LvN -> GA_Accessory_RandomDrink_LvN. GameplayEvent.Medicine.PostActive selects a weighted effect; GhostFire GE grants and activates its matching ability.

targetingFlow.operation: Reset per-scan loop state; iterate existing Pending Ghost Fires.
Require a valid prepared bullet interface.
InitializePreSelectedTarget on the existing prepared bullet.
Clear consumed Pending Ghost Fires slot.

resourceLifecycle.spawn: Original Timer Tick creates one missing-slot bullet, increments Current, and clears spawn timer at Current >= Max.
resourceLifecycle.originalTimers: Retained; binding does not restart the ability, create a bullet, alter Current/Max/Interval or stop a timer.
resourceLifecycle.end: Original K2_OnEndAbility clears both timers and deactivates remaining prepared bullets.
resourceLifecycle.input: Held bindings request the targeting callback each frame; consumed slots prevent reuse until the original spawn timer prepares another ball.
resourceLifecycle.instanceSelection: All naturally active granted live instances, deduplicated by address across replicated/nonreplicated arrays; independent of InstancedPerActor vs InstancedPerExecution.

conditionalEffects.evidence: Consume-Dodge event casts OptionalObject to DeflectFrameConsumePayload, deduplicates Handle in HandledDodgeHandles, then emits three Spawn Bullet calls. Perfect-deflect branch requires a real BulletInterface with Bullet.Tag.Feature.Deflect.CanDodgeAfterDeflect.
conditionalEffects.classification: Attack from a qualified live combat event; Spawn Bullet alone has no event qualification.

conditionalEffects.qualification: Real DamageTakenPayload; active owner/avatar; damage source owner is the avatar; damage cause Damage.Cause.StatusInfliction.Thunder; native cooldown and chain state.
conditionalEffects.classification: Conditional chain damage/thunder; OnLightningChain is a parameterized chain callback.

conditionalEffects.qualification: Real event payload with matching owner avatar, positive finite native value, native accessory level tags, hostile live target, accumulated per-target data and native delay.
conditionalEffects.classification: Conditional damage cascade; event data and queued values are part of the effect.
Immediate weighted drink effect; no granted ability phase or prepared projectile release callback.
Weighted drink GE with separate ally/enemy bullet effects; not a retained prepared projectile.
Immediate weighted drink GE effect; no retained phase callback.

conditionalEffects.qualification: DamagePreTakePayload CurrentPriority=2, damage source owner is player, target has CharacterState.Stand.Break.

limitations: Static package and native code evidence establishes paths and qualification, not an observed game execution.
The 307-package name selection does not prove that every accessory reachable from data tables or characters is inside that subset.

sourceClosure.meaning: A reference closure includes inherited common bases and resources; a reference alone does not assert a grant or an independent action. All 66 accessory ability packages reached from DT_Accessory are included in the named Blueprint audit; seven additional ability packages are common inherited bases.
